notes.title: Optimization | Tavern Manager Simulator v1.4.7
notes.content:
We've updated the game and added an option to improve FPS. For some, it increases the smoothness of animations and increases the average FPS, but on some systems you may not notice the difference.

After public tests, this feature should work stably, but we've moved it to a special section of the menu. It's disabled by default.

To enable it, go to Settings and click Animation Optimization. If you encounter any problems, please send us a report from the game - we'll definitely study it and try to fix it.

MUSICIANS! We're working on a new free update. Stay tuned! If you want to support us, subscribe to our discord.

notes.title: Big Update: Hotel is here!
notes.content:
[h1]🏨 UPDATE: HOTEL 🏨[/h1]
We've been preparing for this moment for a long time and finally added a BIG construction site! Now your guests have a place to relax after a delicious lunch - meet the HOTEL! You will have to greet guests, clean the rooms and keep things cozy.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44820925/3043a466632f32d0fc19dd00cb3a7378bf2c4dcb.gif[/img]

But first, the hotel needs to be built, and a team of highly skilled goblins will help you with this. Don't worry - they will NOT steal your sausage!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44820925/82beb75725d0373313b560b2d54563aa732dac9c.gif[/img]

The hotel becomes available from level 11.

[h3] Other Important Improvements[/h3]
💧 [b]Water Supply Updates[/b]
[list]
[*] New upgrades for the well and water supply system.
[*] Ability to store water and collect it in the new water pump.
[*] Water reserves in the kitchen to spend less time refilling it.
[/list]
💰 [b]Price Controller[/b]
Now you can adjust the prices of dishes!
More visitors or a calm atmosphere? Choose the balance that suits you.

🆘 [b]New button "Help, item stuck!"[/b]
If an item has fallen through the floor or is stuck after an upgrade, solve the problem right in the pause menu.

🧚 [b]Flexible customization of fairy waitresses[/b]
[list]
[*] Determine which halls they work in.
[*] Choose whether they will do cleaning.
[*] Set their priorities so that the work is more efficient!
[/list]
✅ [b]Fixes and minor improvements[/b]
[list]
[*] Visitors no longer get stuck near the toilet.
[*] Fairies now have cute wings and work magic while working. 
[*] In the VIP hall, the screens have become lower - orders are now visible.
[*] NPC walking animations play correctly even if you slightly... hit them.
[/list]

[h2]The update is now available! Thank you for playing! ❤️[/h2]

If you want to support us, then add our next game to your wishlist - a co-op anime shop simulator

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3393280/Anime_Shop_Simulator/

or buy a DLC with unique tavern signs

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3387950/Tavern_Manager_Simulator_Supporter_Pack_DLC/

[h2]Join our discord and follow the news[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44820925/f02193351de2044bbf90e7f0c23d1096719a3c5d.gif[/img]

notes.title: Freezing Pit is available now! 🔥
notes.content:
[h2][b]Hello, Innkeepers![/b][/h2]

We are pleased to present you with a content update that will add even more possibilities to your game. In this update, we focused on adding new gameplay and fixing common issues. Here's what awaits you in the new version:

[h3][b]Freezing Pit and New Dishes[/b][/h3]
Now you can buy a new tavern update - Freezing Pit!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44820925/b8a7157426ca2edb2dad4f602fceb30f2d6bc4a4.gif[/img]

[h3][b]New type of customer - guards[/b][/h3]
Guards will now visit the tavern. These tough guys want to relax after work - keep a supply of cold drinks for them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44820925/4d645b1af0da896ea9f7e5c9cc8b5eab380394a1.gif[/img]

[h3][b]Improvements[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] You can now pick up the dish you're looking at, not the first one on the edge.
[*] Items that accidentally fall through the tavern floor will be returned to your inventory.
[*] Updated the thief model - don't miss him!
[*] We've added more randomness to the seating arrangements. The second floor should fill up much more often now.
[*] We've seen a few complaints about the game freezing. This update may help.
[/list]

[h3][b]New DLC[/b][/h3]
We have released a small Supporter Pack for those who want to further support us. It includes unique images and animated signs for your tavern.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3387950/Tavern_Manager_Simulator_Supporter_Pack_DLC/

We continue to develop the tavern, but at the same time we started making our next simulator in which you can manage an Anime Shop! Add to Wishlist!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3393280/Anime_Shop_Simulator/

[h3][b]May your tavern prosper and delight visitors! Good luck in managing and see you in the next update. 😊[/b][/h3]

notes.title: Cleaning and Improvements | Tavern Manager Simulator v1.0.11
notes.content:
[h3]Oktoberfeast is over.  Thank you all for participating. And now improvements are here![/h3]

[b]Gameplay:[/b]
[list]
[*] New fairy profession - cleaner. She cleans dirty footprints, scattered trash, dirty spots from the table and cleans the toilet (available from level 8)
[*] New line of improvements - mats at the entrance. They reduce the amount of dirty footprints left by guests.
[*] New improvement - remote opening/closing of the tavern right from the bar counter.
[/list]

[b]Improvements:[/b]
[list]
[*] A green arrow now appears above the table if new customers are approaching it.
[*] Changes in the gold counter are now written in gold, so as not to confuse it with reputation.
[*] The fullness of the warehouse is also displayed in the inventory.
[*] More plates for meat from the start.
[/list]

[b]Fairies:[/b]
[list]
[*] The logic of fairies has been reworked - they are better at choosing what and where to carry and should not fall into a stupor from carrying the wrong items to the wrong place.
[*] Increased flight speed.
[*] Markers now appear above tables if fairies are about to bring an order to that table or remove dirty dishes from it.
[/list]

[b]Optimization:[/b]
[list]
[*] Improved performance, optimized complex visual areas - the game should work faster and put less load on the system.
[/list]

notes.content:
[h3]Calling all tavern owners! The kingdom is celebrating Oktoberfeast, and your tavern will not be left out.[/h3]

[h3]🍂 Tavern will be transformed[/h3]
As the holiday begins, your tavern will automatically be decorated with special holiday decorations.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44820925/3973b793b520c0e0df8f5841c4fb53f51e720b22.png[/img]

notes.title: DevLog #4 Tavern Development
notes.content:
Tavern development is one of the key features in the game. You will feel how your Tavern grows bigger and better. Gain experience, earn gold, and buy new level.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44820925/d6ce12529998a84ceabc3fa6c4034711fdbd025a.png[/img]

[h2]Level 1[/h2]
A small, modest building. If you clean it up, you can put in a few tables.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44820925/c3ec43eb4bce41e844078e5b1baaa9e9b6d8582d.png[/img]

[h2]Level 5[/h2]
Now we have a kitchen! You can cook hot soup and tasty meat.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44820925/1263e8cd0e948ef651641c2c6bdcead2cb368e66.png[/img]

[h2]Level 10[/h2]
Two floors! Now there's definitely enough space for everyone. Maybe we can even set up a stage for artists.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44820925/de7a3587e29e6fbb907307d2fac0d63c507b09e2.png[/img]

[h2]Level 15[/h2]
Time to dance and listen to lively music! It would be great to have a summer terrace.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44820925/f3a55cbe68560b199aa68d7e70dc7bff9da8d789.png[/img]

[b][h2]Join us in Discord![/h2][/b] https://discord.gg/suYcCmPeXe


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44820925/da8b1ca645f41cd6e8db23975ee738b39ef09715.gif[/img]

notes.content:

Now the game features a full day and night cycle. Lanterns light up at night, and you can even see the lights in the castle on the hill. Maybe there's a princess waiting for you there?
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44820925/8608c9133767a10fa677899d2a769c2f97029447.gif[/img]

We have added various types of weather conditions. From rain to a meteor shower. No matter what the weather is like outside - the tavern awaits guests.
